snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Psypher
snippet.description:
Introducing the Psypher!

Taking control of the battlefield with its free-wielding Force capabilities, the Psypher can effectively engage multiple enemies at once. It pulls in enemies from a distance, and uses Taunt and AoE skills to dismantle enemy formations and deploy strategies that turn the battle in its favor.

Converting Force into raw power, this battlefield commander is a lethal asset on the field—experience the Psypher biosuit's combat capabilities today!
